notes: A cheap pipeline case against the shared tinytask fixture, used as the routine-issue case of a paired trial corpus; it stops after test-first, so review, push and ship are never exercised.

evals.name: direct-issue-through-test-first
evals.prompt:
Use the `deliver-direct` skill to deliver `issues/003-mechanical.md`.

Resolve once into a retained ResolvedProject. A resolver refusal is fatal and values are never defaulted or inferred. The tracker capability is unsupported, so this file is the issue: treat it as issue 3 for branch naming, and skip step 1's claim and every tracker call. Work in the worktree step 2 creates.

**Stop after step 3 (Test first).** Commit the change on the worktree branch, report the branch, and stop: no review, no push, no pull request, no merge.
evals.expected_output: A worktree on an `issue-3-<slug>` branch holding one or more commits that rename the flag, with the fixture's tests passing. main is unmoved locally and at origin, nothing is pushed, and no spec or plan is written.

asserts.name: a worktree was created
asserts.shell: [ -n "$WT" ] || fail "no worktree beyond the base checkout"

asserts.name: nothing was pushed
asserts.shell: [ -z "$(git -C "$ORIGIN" for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' refs/heads/ | grep -vx refs/heads/main)" ] || fail "a branch reached origin despite the stop"

asserts.name: local and origin main are unchanged
asserts.shell: { [ "$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse main)" = "$BASE_MAIN" ] && [ "$(git -C "$ORIGIN" rev-parse main)" = "$BASE_MAIN" ]; } || fail "main moved"

asserts.name: the implementation is committed on the worktree branch
asserts.shell: commits_touch "$WT" tinytask && [ -z "$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- tinytask tests README.md)" ] || fail "the implementation in $WT differs from HEAD: it is not all committed"

asserts.name: the renamed flag works through the CLI
asserts.shell: f="$WORK/flagcheck.json"; rm -f "$f"; cli() { (cd "$WORK" && PYTHONPATH="$WT" python3 -m tinytask --file "$f" "$@" 2>&1); }; { cli add x >/dev/null && cli done 1 >/dev/null && [ -z "$(cli list)" ] && [ "$(cli list --include-done)" = "$(printf '1\tdone\tx')" ] && ! cli list --all >/dev/null && cli list --help | grep -q -e --include-done && ! cli list --help | grep -q -e --all; } || fail "the CLI in $WT does not behave as the issue's acceptance criteria say"

asserts.name: the worktree branch is named for issue 3
asserts.shell: git -C "$WT" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^issue-3-' || fail "the worktree branch is not issue-3-<slug>"

asserts.name: the fixture's tests pass in the worktree
asserts.shell: (cd "$WT" && TMPDIR="$WORK" python3 -m unittest discover -q 2>/dev/null) || fail "fixture tests fail in $WT"

asserts.name: no occurrence of the old flag remains
asserts.shell: [ -z "$(git -C "$WT" grep -n -e '--all' -- tinytask/cli.py tests/test_cli.py README.md)" ] || fail "the old flag is still named"

asserts.name: no spec or plan was written
asserts.shell: dirs_empty "$WT/${SPEC_DIR#"$REPO"/}" "$WT/${PLAN_DIR#"$REPO"/}" || fail "a spec or plan was written on the direct lane"
